dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have you heard about that other "you"?

dialogues.speaker: Atsuko
dialogues.text: Oh? You mean the one who was staying with my parents at one point?

dialogues.speaker: Atsuko
dialogues.text: Um, how should I put it... It's such a strange story...

dialogues.speaker: Atsuko
dialogues.text: That said, I'd love to meet "her" if I have the chance.

dialogues.speaker: Atsuko
dialogues.text: Who knows, "she" might be able to help me out a bit.
